clue.text: Far' and close mingle together in the open

indicators.note: letters that mingle together are mixed up, so the two words are rearranged as one pool

explanation.surface: Distant and nearby things blend in the outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mingle together' tells you to rearrange the letters of FAR and CLOSE together.
explanation.definitionFit: Done outside, under the sky, as in an outdoor meal.

clue.text: Chief that is worse company head for province

parts.note: arch- as a prefix means chief or principal
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is
pis is French for worse, as in pis aller
pate is an old word for the head

explanation.surface: A leader goes from bad to worse while running a regional firm.
explanation.walkthrough: PIS needs the French for worse, known in English through 'pis aller', a last resort.
explanation.definitionFit: The province or see governed by an archbishop, a church district.

clue.text: About fifty items on the menu are water

indicators.note: the menu items go round the fifty, enclosing it

parts.note: what a menu lists is food
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Around fifty dishes on a menu are just water.
explanation.definitionFit: To flood is to water heavily, drenching land or crops.

clue.text: The selfish make the street sit up under Eastern attempt

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece placed under the others comes after them

parts.note: a go is an attempt

indicators.note: in a down clue, sending the words upward reads them backwards

explanation.surface: Self-centred people make the road stand to attention after an Eastern effort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns both short words round together, and in a down clue 'under' sets that reversed run beneath the Eastern attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-centred people who think only of themselves, used as a collective plural noun.

clue.text: If it were so cold in China, furs would be needed

definitions.text: If it were so cold in China, furs would be needed

parts.words: If it were so cold in China, furs would be needed
parts.note: a whimsical picture of a cold country needing furs, playing on the start of China being followed by a word for cold

explanation.surface: A cold snap in China would have everyone reaching for their furs.
explanation.definitionFit: A word meaning cold or coldness, the kind of weather that calls for warm clothing.

clue.text: Blows for bad beer

definitions.meaning: an old slang word for thin, poor-quality beer

explanation.definitionFit: Hits made with a sweeping motion; also historic slang for weak, sour ale.

clue.text: Rank is put up above your notability

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits above the second
in a down clue, putting a word up reverses its letters

parts.note: a rank is a row, as of soldiers
thy is the old form of your

explanation.surface: Status is raised above your fame.
explanation.definitionFit: A worthy is a distinguished, important person, a local dignitary.

clue.text: Nicety is play on words caught and grease it up

parts.note: a pun is a play on words
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: in a down clue the words grease and it are read upward, so backwards

parts.note: oil is a grease or lubricant

explanation.surface: A fine point about a joke that was caught out, with something greased up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses OIL and IT together to give TILIO.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine point of conduct or ceremony, a matter of strict punctiliousness.

clue.text: A lot of whales overcoming education

parts.note: a school is a group of whales or fish
mastering means overcoming or conquering

explanation.surface: Defeating a great pod of whales counts as learning.
explanation.definitionFit: The work of a teacher in a school, teaching pupils.

clue.text: Maybe a gate holding rubbish for one who gets through

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hold the rubbish inside them
maybe suggests the letters of 'a gate' may be arranged otherwise

parts.note: rot is nonsense or rubbish

explanation.surface: Perhaps a gateway filled with junk lets someone pass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Maybe' rearranges A GATE into AEGAT, and 'holding' puts ROT inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A university degree or pass awarded to a student too ill to sit the examinations.

clue.text: Reptile with fish in its middle

definitions.text: Reptile with fish in its middle

parts.words: Reptile with fish in its middle
parts.note: the name of a large reptile has the letters of a common fish at its centre, and the beast also eats fish

explanation.surface: A reptile that has just swallowed a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A large river reptile of the tropics, a scaly predator with powerful jaws.

clue.text: Part of bank loses capital for farm

indicators.note: losing its capital means the word drops its first letter

parts.note: a branch is a local office of a bank

explanation.surface: A local bank office loses its money and becomes agricultural.
explanation.definitionFit: A large farm for raising cattle, especially in the Americas.

clue.text: Lemur in the main dried out

indicators.note: the lemur's name sits inside the run of letters in these two words

explanation.surface: A lemur at sea has dried out.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest living lemur, from Madagascar.

clue.text: God and the Jews get together slowly

parts.note: a lar is a Roman household god
a ghetto was the quarter where Jews were made to live together

explanation.surface: A deity and a Jewish community gather together at a leisurely pace.
explanation.walkthrough: LAR is one of the Lares, Roman household gods.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning rather slowly, a little faster than largo.

clue.text: Where one has a language in the head

indicators.note: the pieces go inside the word for the head

parts.note: pate is an old word for the head
A means one, as in a single
Latin is a classical language

explanation.surface: Where someone keeps a language in their mind.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'Where': a palatinate is a region, so the whole clue reads as a riddle about a place.
explanation.definitionFit: A palatinate is a territory ruled by a count palatine, so it names a place.

clue.text: Length is almost noisier without northern fool

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the shortened word goes outside the others
almost means the word stops short of its final letter

parts.note: louder means noisier
git is British slang for a fool

explanation.surface: Distance is almost louder without a northern idiot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts LOUDER to LOUDE, and 'without' puts it outside N and GIT. GIT is British slang for a contemptible fool.
explanation.definitionFit: Longitude is angular distance east or west, and in old use simply length.

clue.text: Bird has to produce chicks under upturned cask

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece sits under the first
in a down clue an upturned word is read from the bottom up, so backwards

parts.note: a tun is a large cask
to hatch is to produce chicks from eggs

explanation.surface: A bird has to rear chicks beneath an upside-down barrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A small songbird that climbs trees and cracks nuts.

clue.text: Desirable thing which is in the lead, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the clue words are taken as said aloud

parts.note: a plumb is a lead weight on a line

explanation.surface: Something desirable that is in front, so we are told.
explanation.walkthrough: A plumb is a lead weight; the word comes from Latin plumbum, lead.
explanation.definitionFit: A plum is a prize, a choice job or position everyone wants.

clue.text: Money I am almost able to make for vegetables

parts.note: brass is British slang for money

indicators.note: almost means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: can means is able

explanation.surface: I am nearly able to make money from vegetables.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts CAN to CA. BRASS is northern British slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: The cabbage genus, taking in cabbages, sprouts and turnips.

clue.text: Done wrong for the province, by the sound of it

indicators.note: the phrase tells us the word for done wrong is said aloud

parts.note: to have sinned is to have done wrong

explanation.surface: A region that seems to have behaved badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Sindh, also spelt Sind, a province of Pakistan on the Indus.

clue.text: Talks about space for cabins

indicators.note: the word for talks goes about, around, the space

parts.note: states means declares or talks
room means space

explanation.surface: A chat about where to find room aboard ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Private cabins on a ship, the better berths.

clue.text: Taking no tricks exists in French female

indicators.note: the word for exists is placed in the French word

parts.note: mère is French for mother, a female parent
is means exists

explanation.surface: Living in a French woman's world.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games such as solo whist, a bid to win no tricks at all.

clue.text: Start to speak about a drink

indicators.note: the speaking word goes about, around, the other pieces

parts.note: orate means to speak formally
I is the Roman numeral one, as a means one
gin is a drink

explanation.surface: Begin by talking about getting a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To start or begin, bringing something into being.

clue.text: Bob has left so intercourse is precise

parts.note: Bob, who has left, is a former partner, an ex
the sex act is intercourse

explanation.surface: Bob walked out, so the sex is now exact.
explanation.definitionFit: Exact means accurate, strictly correct.

clue.text: Sugary sound of train

indicators.note: sound of means the clue word is taken as it is said

parts.note: sweet means sugary

explanation.surface: The sweet noise of a railway train.
explanation.definitionFit: A train in the sense of a retinue, the followers of a great person.

clue.text: Terrorists question one as a Middle Easterner

parts.note: the IRA was the Irish Republican Army
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Terrorists interrogate someone from the Gulf.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Iraq, a country in the Middle East.

clue.text: Entertain a female of nine

parts.note: the Muses were nine goddesses of the arts

explanation.surface: Delight a woman in a group of nine.
explanation.definitionFit: To divert or delight someone.

clue.text: Cacophony is two-thirds cleaner before four

annotationWithheld.why: Cacophony is two-thirds cleaner before four (9): CHAR (cleaner) + IV (four) leaves ARI unaccounted for; 'two-thirds' fits no printed word, so the clue as held appears garbled
annotationWithheld.clue: Cacophony is two-thirds cleaner before four

clue.text: Team for the Spanish followed by two, for example

indicators.note: the first piece is followed by the second in the answer

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
two is an example of an even number

explanation.surface: A Spanish team followed by a pair, say.
explanation.definitionFit: A side of this many players, as in cricket or football.

clue.text: Performance of craft or cooker

parts.note: describes what a steamship does on the water and what a pan of water does on a stove

explanation.surface: How a ship or a kitchen pan does its work.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving under vapour power like a ship, or cooking food in vapour.
